title: Football foundations: build a practice routine
notice: Illustrative adult-only draft for qualified coaching review. Not an approved program or a claim of firsthand testing. No automatic import, assignment or publication.

sessions.title: Ready position and controlled steps
sessions.purpose: Introduce a clear setup, short practice sequence and one coaching cue at a time.
sessions.lesson: Use a comfortable balanced starting position and controlled walking-pace movements. This draft includes no contact or maximal-speed activity.
practiceSteps: Check the space and walk comfortably before starting.
Place two markers a few walking steps apart.
Set a comfortable ready position, walk to the second marker, then reset.
Use a short set of controlled repetitions with a rest between sets; the reviewing coach must set the final count and timing.
sessions.coachingCue: Stay balanced and keep each step controlled.
sessions.nextDrill: Reset and repeat only after reviewing the cue.

sessions.title: Ball familiarity and attention
sessions.purpose: Build on the practice routine using a football or a soft substitute at a controlled pace.
sessions.lesson: Practice handling an object while maintaining comfortable balance and awareness. This draft includes no contact, tackling or competitive catching.
practiceSteps: Check the practice space and review the first session's cue.
While standing comfortably, hold and reposition the ball slowly.
Add a few controlled walking steps only if the reviewing coach approves the progression.
Pause, reset and describe what felt clear or confusing; the coach must approve final repetitions and rest.
sessions.coachingCue: Control the ball, then look up and reset.
sessions.nextDrill: Return to the simpler standing version when the sequence becomes unclear.
reviewChecklist: Approve the football technique and progression
